caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a flat lid, rendered in muted tones. The body of the chest is painted in a blue-green color, with the lid and base appearing as brown wood with darker accents. The front panel of the chest is decorated with three arched sections, each containing a central vase or urn that holds stylized flowers and leaves. These vases are gray-green, and the flowers and foliage are depicted in shades of red, orange, brown, and black, surrounded by decorative patterns in similar colors. The arches are bordered with a reddish-pink tone, and there is a repeating motif of leaves and abstract shapes. The chest stands on a dark, bracketed base. The drawing is signed "FRANCES LICHTEN" in small red letters on the left side near the chest. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or furniture shown.
title: Chest
